description: Texas enforcement dossier — the whole Legal Shelf (premium). Premium: the Legal Shelf as one dossier for a Texas enforcement matter — county fee cards, abstracts and recording, post-judgment discovery and motion-to-compel, execution, garnishment, turnover, exemptions, dormancy and revival. All 37 v1 records with a fee-confirmation summary (unconfirmed fees named, never estimated). General information, not legal advice. $5 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
